verdict.rationale: Customer.io's own docs point developers to official SDKs: "use an SDK or the Pipelines API" to get data in. A dedicated SDK page covers identifying people and sending push, rich push and in-app messages to mobile app users, and there is a JavaScript client snippet. An OpenAPI spec is published, which supports building against the APIs. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported SDK languages and platforms, evidence of server-side SDKs, SDK-specific guidance for AI-native workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
